versions.content: If a Crypto Driver API is called and any buffer addressed during the operation is too small, then the operation shall not be performed. If development error detection for the Crypto Driver is enabled, then the API function shall report CRYPTO_E_SMALL_BUFFER to the DET, else return E_NOT_OK .
